observations.quality: Without confirmed profile facts, the model still asks for personal details. Faster clarification is not a personalized introduction.
The final optimized model directly explained simpler APIs and fewer round trips instead of asking an unnecessary clarification.
The reply preserved the faster-sync and batched-call explanation. Technical-term transcription errors remain.

balancedExploration.note: Three same-input observations were mixed: all selected knowledge routing and no final response reused a prefetch.

confirmedProfileCheck.observedReply: My name is Mina; my role is Software engineer. My current project is Evaluating email client interoperability.

limitations: This is a bounded before/after observation, not the proposed 100-question real-meeting acceptance corpus.
No human-annotated acoustic end or gold transcript is available; neither p95 nor recognition accuracy is claimed.
Conversation mode deliberately trades document grounding for avoiding retrieval latency; use knowledge mode when evidence is required.
The conservative prefetch implementation is regression-tested but had zero measured final-response hits in these clips.
Profile composition uses only user-confirmed fields and is clearly labelled as not model-generated.
One baseline exporter exited nonzero on PowerShell's default text decoding after the raw browser run completed; UTF-8 evidence was recovered and independently analyzed. The exporter was corrected.
A Windows Playwright 1.63 run stalled; pinned 1.61.1 subsequently completed all 27 browser cases. This is not a guarantee against all OS/network stalls.
Voice Live comparison and a WebSocket-worker rewrite are not included in this release.
